name: popover
title: Popover
description: A Leave a note button that morphs into a large rounded form with a placeholder, a textarea, and close and submit buttons in its footer.
use: You want a lightweight note or comment form that opens right where the trigger sits.
avoid: It is fixed at 364px wide and only suits short notes; long text has no room to grow.
a11y: The textarea has no label or placeholder attribute, and focus is not trapped or returned; the panel has no dialog role. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A compact dark Leave a note pill sits on black. Clicked, it grows into a wide rounded dark panel with faint grey placeholder text top-left, a small X at the bottom-left and a bordered Submit button at the bottom-right.
behaves: The button expands into the panel with a light spring; typing hides the placeholder, and the X, an outside click or Escape closes it and clears the note while the panel shrinks back.
customise: Trigger text, placeholder and footer buttons are composed from exported parts; the fixed 364x200 size and spring live in the source.
weight: light: One panel with a single layout morph; idle while closed.
demo: Button reading Leave a note, placeholder Your note, and the typed line Invite Sam to the design review.
issues: The textarea has no label or placeholder attribute, so its purpose is only visual.
Focus is neither trapped in the panel nor returned to the trigger.
The panel behaves like a dialog but has no dialog role.
polishWhy: Clean morph and clear footer actions; it is a plain note form with basic a11y gaps.
